profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker DT. According to its website, it sells observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform, aimed at helping customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and drive better business outcomes. The company describes itself as the AI-powered observability leader and says its platform turns data into decisions and autonomous actions. Its site quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. A customer quote on the site credits the Dynatrace AI engine with early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing root cause identification from hours to minutes.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001773383. Its held record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. It is recorded with law exposure in Massachusetts, where 191 cases are counted.
